# TheCollector

> TheCollector is an academic platform publishing scholarly articles, educational videos, and historical resources on history, culture, and classical antiquity.

TheCollector serves as a comprehensive resource for history education and scholarly research, offering peer-reviewed articles, downloadable maps, and video content spanning ancient civilizations, medieval history, and cultural studies. The platform combines academic rigor with accessible educational content for students, educators, and history enthusiasts.

## Key Topics

- Ancient History
- Ancient Greece
- Ancient Rome
- Ancient Athens
- Medieval History
- Historical Analysis
- Scholarly Content
- Historical Maps
- Ancient Civilizations
- Military History
- Classical Antiquity
- History Education
- Academic Articles
- Historical Resources
- Empire Studies

## Core Resources & Archives

- [TheCollector Homepage](https://www.thecollector.com): Academic platform publishing scholarly articles on history, culture, and education.
- [Maps & Historical Resources](https://www.thecollector.com/maps-resources): Free downloadable historical maps and resources for ancient civilizations and battles.
- [Videos](https://www.thecollector.com/videos): Educational video content on history, art, philosophy, and classical antiquity.

## Scholarly Articles

- [What Did Ancient Greek Juries Look Like?](https://www.thecollector.com/ancient-athenian-juries): Examination of ancient Athenian jury systems and their role in Greek democracy.
- [Why Head Coverings Mattered in Early Christianity](https://www.thecollector.com/head-coverings-early-christianity): Scholarly article on head coverings in early Christianity and New Testament interpretation.
- [What Were Three Major Effects of the Black Death?](https://www.thecollector.com/major-effects-of-the-black-death): Historical analysis of Black Death's impact on medieval European society and labor.

## Contributor Guidelines

- [Write for Us](https://www.thecollector.com/write-for-us): Guidelines for academic contributors and writers to submit content to TheCollector.
